definitions.merchandise_field: The canvas minus reserved copy regions (presenter/logo block, headline block, event block, help/support lines, place plate) and minus the navy band. Coverage is measured inside this field, not over the whole canvas, so a bigger headline never 'fixes' a small cluster.
definitions.coverage_pct: merchandise (or photograph) mask area ÷ merchandise_field area × 100
definitions.cluster_extent: bounding box of the union of merchandise masks, as a fraction of the merchandise field's width and height
definitions.largest_accidental_void_pct: largest empty rectangle (existing compose._largest_empty_rect) over the field, excluding regions the scene plan declares intentional
definitions.intentional_negative_space: declared in the scene plan with a reason (e.g. SINGLE_LOT dark field around a lit object; a deliberate breathing zone beside a headline). Declared regions are excluded from the void measure and reported separately.

SINGLE_LOT.note: negative space is often intentional here and must be declared; undeclared voids still count

ENVIRONMENTAL_PHOTO.note: coverage = photograph area of the field; the photograph should bleed to both side edges

ACQUISITION.note: Individual Seller C measured 12.4% of the CANVAS (far less of a field that had a contact card in it); Individual Seller A measured 33.6% of the canvas with a full-width cluster and was not criticised for coverage

RESTRAINED_FACTUAL.note: typography carries the canvas; white space here is by design and is declared as such in the plan

gates.hard_floor: coverage_pct below the family minimum by more than 10 points, or largest_accidental_void_pct above the cap by more than 4 points → HARD FAIL (regenerate), not a partial score. Individual Seller C and West University B fail here.
gates.soft_band: inside the band → full points; within 10 points below / 4 points above → linear loss; the scorer's measurable block uses these instead of the 3P bands
gates.copy_regions_protected: the cluster may never enter reserved copy regions; a cluster scaled into a copy region is re-planned, not clipped

fit_procedure.1: Compute the merchandise field from the layout's reserved copy regions.
fit_procedure.2: Plan the cluster physically (Mission 5) at scene scale; compute its extent.
fit_procedure.3: Scale the whole cluster uniformly (relationships and relative scale preserved) so that its extent reaches the family's cluster_extent_w minimum, capped by the scale model's anchor maximum (an anchor may not exceed 100% of the field height for scene families).
fit_procedure.4: If extent_h is still under the minimum: add height with a tall object (floor lamp, cabinet, tall sculpture, hung wall art above an anchor) from the eligible set — never by stretching, never by enlarging small objects past their scale tolerance.
fit_procedure.5: If coverage_pct is still under the band: add objects from the eligible set by anchor_weight then foreground_suitability, re-plan, re-audit. Never inflate a small object to fill space (that is how bowls become table-sized).
fit_procedure.6: Re-measure voids. A void the plan did not declare and that exceeds the cap → reposition the cluster (shift toward the void, re-check copy regions) before considering any other change.
fit_procedure.7: If the band still cannot be met with the available CLEAN objects, change family (fewer, larger objects: LEFT_THIRD_WHITE; one object: SINGLE_LOT) rather than accept an under-filled canvas.
